findings: Exact gmu_core_map_memdesc body never writes memdesc->gmuaddr. It passes only domain/address/scatterlist/count/attrs to kgsl_mmu_map_sg; temporary SG construction failure returns its original error without attempting a map. The new source closes the prior descriptor-mutation unknown at this layer.

The dynamic caller reserved local addr but on failure looks up md->gmuaddr. The lower helper does not set that field; for an initially different value this is not the attempted reservation address. No actual failed phone mapping is claimed; this is a reference-source mismatch.

The core function preserves a negative mapper result, converts zero to -ENOMEM and folds any positive byte count to0 without comparing against memdesc->size. It exposes no mapped byte count or cleanup return and invokes no explicit unmap in this body.

The exact kgsl_mmu wrapper forwards to iommu_map_sg with GFP_KERNEL for kernel>=6.2, otherwise the five-argument form. The selected Linux core implementation/configuration and real rollback behavior remain unbound; failure must not authorize native release.

Current NativeAdrenoVm map records a real device reference and mapping metadata before cache publication. A cache publication failure is folded by fail(ArmSmmu4KIoError) to generic IOReturnIOError, losing the raw native publication status in its previous result. Source-only repair captures that first raw32 cache error in separate persistent private metadata before fail.

The repair does not change the outward mapping return, retry/cleanup/poisoning behavior or hardware permissions. Its separate persistent field survives ordinary result_ clearing, so a later operation cannot erase the original error. Only map-publication errors are covered; no universal native error capture is claimed.
result.host_scope: Only the byte-bound exact GPL reference function body runs negative/zero-map/SG-construction failure paths with scalar failure diagnostics. No successful SG allocator, map, address or handle model; no Darwin native method is run. Host projection is not Linux struct/layout or native ABI proof.
